_meta.description: Research interests shown on Home and research experiences shown on Research.

fields.experiences: Array of items with title, period, role, advisor, funding, summary, bullets, tags and optional related links

interests.title: Multi-robot Coordination
interests.description: Distributed decision-making for aerial-ground teams under communication constraints.

interests.title: Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
interests.description: Centralised training with decentralised execution for pursuit-evasion and exploration tasks.

interests.title: Vision-Language Navigation
interests.description: Linking high-level instructions with onboard perception for autonomous mobility.

interests.title: Embedded Autonomy
interests.description: Deployable autonomy stacks on resource-limited edge hardware.

experiences.title: Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning with Communication
experiences.summary: Research assistant at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) after completing the master's degree, focusing on multi-agent reinforcement learning with communication.
bullets: Research focus: the integration of inter-agent communication and multi-agent policy learning for cooperative decision-making.

experiences.title: Intelligent Swarm Pursuit-Evasion under Incomplete Information
experiences.funding: National Natural Science Foundation of China
experiences.summary: Studied MARL policies for aerial swarms that adapt between local exploration and burst communication under incomplete information.
bullets: Raised pursuit success to 91% in the NP-1E pursuit-evasion environment.
Filed multiple published invention patents on UAV coordination and sparse-reward exploration.

experiences.title: Autonomous UAV–Ground Vehicle Navigation
experiences.summary: Developing navigation stack combining RGB, LiDAR, odometry for indoor logistics.
bullets: Implemented dual control modes with constraint-aware planning.
Achieved 10 cm arrival accuracy in dynamic test arenas.

experiences.title: Multi-UAV Formation Control and Simulation
experiences.summary: Studied multi-UAV formation control during the master's programme, implementing square, circular and flocking formations with collision avoidance in MATLAB and Python simulations.
bullets: Implemented 2D and 3D square formations using artificial potential fields and a leader–follower structure, and ring-topology formations using distributed consensus control.
Reproduced and extended an existing flocking implementation with target tracking, obstacle avoidance and trajectory visualisation, building on MSN-Flocking-Formation-Control.
Analysed simulated trajectories, velocity evolution, connectivity and centroid motion; published code and visualisation tools in three GitHub repositories.

experiences.title: Visual-Inertial SLAM for Autonomous UAVs
experiences.summary: Integrated IMU and vision for warehouse-scale SLAM and obstacle-aware planning.
bullets: Maintained <0.3 m drift over 10-minute flights.
Automated waypoint navigation through cluttered aisles.

experiences.title: TOTAL: Multi-Corner Timing Optimisation with Transfer and Active Learning
experiences.summary: Contributed to TOTAL, a machine-learning framework for multi-corner static timing analysis and optimisation of integrated circuits, with work on data preprocessing, model validation and benchmark experiments.
bullets: Supported Gaussian-process-based timing prediction using transfer and active learning, including experimental data preparation and model validation for the 15 nm technology node.
Ran experiments on the b17, b18 and b19 benchmarks, collected results and analysed critical-path prediction across timing optimisation iterations.
Contributed experimental data and validation results to “TOTAL: Multi-Corners Timing Optimization Based on Transfer and Active Learning”, published at ACM/IEEE DAC 2023.

interests.title: 多机器人协同控制
interests.description: 聚焦空中异构编队，在受限通信条件下设计稳定可靠的分布式决策策略。

interests.title: 多智能体强化学习
interests.description: 研究集中训练、分散执行架构，支撑追逃博弈与大规模探索等任务场景。

interests.title: 视觉-语言导航
interests.description: 将自然语言指令与机载感知深度结合，构建可解释的自主导航能力。

interests.title: 嵌入式无人系统
interests.description: 在边缘算力受限的硬件上部署轻量化感知决策链路，兼顾鲁棒性与实时性。

experiences.title: 融合通信机制的多智能体强化学习
experiences.role: 研究助理（RA）· 香港科技大学（广州）
experiences.summary: 硕士毕业后，在香港科技大学（广州）HKUST(GZ) 担任研究助理，研究方向为结合智能体通信的多智能体强化学习（MARL with Communication）。
bullets: 围绕协同决策，研究智能体间的通信机制与多智能体策略学习的结合。

experiences.title: 不完全信息条件下智能群体追逃博弈算法研究
experiences.funding: 资助：国家自然科学基金项目
experiences.summary: 围绕空中协同编队，探索在局部探索与突发通信之间自适应切换的多智能体强化学习策略。
bullets: 在 NP-1E 追逃环境中将捕获成功率提升至 91%。
申请多项无人机协同与稀疏奖励探索相关发明专利并已公开。

experiences.title: 无人机-无人车协同导航系统
experiences.advisor: 合作单位：美团机器人研究院（深圳）
experiences.funding: 合作类型：产学研联合项目
experiences.summary: 搭建融合 RGB、LiDAR 与里程计的室内物流导航系统，提升调度弹性与执行精度。
bullets: 实现考虑底层约束的双模式控制器，支持自动切换与调度策略组合。
在动态测试场景下实现 10 cm 级到达精度。

experiences.title: 多飞行器编队控制与仿真研究
experiences.role: 硕士研究生 · 西安电子科技大学
experiences.summary: 硕士期间围绕多无人机编队形成、协同运动与碰撞避免开展研究，使用 MATLAB 与 Python 实现四边形、环形及仿鸟群编队的控制与仿真。
bullets: 结合人工势场与领导者—跟随者结构实现二维、三维四边形编队，并基于环形拓扑与分布式一致性控制实现环形编队。
基于已有的 MSN-Flocking-Formation-Control 开源实现复现并改进 flocking 算法，完善目标跟踪、障碍物避碰与轨迹可视化。
通过仿真轨迹、速度变化、系统连通性与质心运动分析编队行为，在三个 GitHub 仓库中公开代码与可视化工具。

experiences.title: 面向仓储的视觉惯性 SLAM
experiences.funding: 资助：本科毕业论文项目
experiences.summary: 融合惯导与视觉信息，完成仓储环境中的 SLAM 构建与避障路径规划。
bullets: 10 分钟自主飞行的累计漂移控制在 0.3 m 以内。
实现复杂货架通道内的自主航点巡航与避障。

experiences.title: TOTAL：基于迁移与主动学习的芯片多工况时序优化
experiences.role: 研究助理（RA）· 北京航空航天大学
experiences.summary: 参与面向集成电路多工况静态时序分析与优化的机器学习框架 TOTAL，承担数据预处理、模型验证与基准实验工作。
bullets: 参与基于高斯过程回归、迁移学习与主动学习的时序预测研究，支持 15 nm 工艺节点的实验数据准备与模型验证。
在 b17、b18、b19 基准电路上开展实验，收集并分析多轮时序优化中的关键路径预测结果。
为发表于 ACM/IEEE DAC 2023 的论文《TOTAL: Multi-Corners Timing Optimization Based on Transfer and Active Learning》提供实验数据与验证结果。
